purpose: Matched shared-core object campaigns through a single shared canonical mailbox broker, TCP loopback. Host-process qualification only, not guest or WAN evidence.

dose.registered_fixtures: Existing fixtures::mixed_objects; all eight target byte strings match across arms. Combined pays checkpoint and schema publication setup.

authority_and_protocol.protocol: Existing canonical encrypted MVM Call/Reply and encrypted destination-admission receipts; same object-v1 codec and durable publication contract.
authority_and_protocol.shared_budget: One injected BrokerContext shared by sender and receiver roles on TCP loopback; native witness identity limits unchanged.
authority_and_protocol.synthetic_grant: Explicitly re-signed two-outstanding-Call local grant accounts for both endpoint roles in one host domain, as existing shared-broker test. Production remote provisioning remains one.
authority_and_protocol.limit_policy: Do not raise the witness Call cap or quotas. Larger raw mixed campaigns may exceed that unchanged cap; preserve the refusal and mark the comparison incomplete.

baseline: RawMixed, WholeMixed and CombinedCpu all use the existing exact-object warm probe. RawMixed means raw byte codec plus shared exact-object cache, not cacheless raw resend. WholeMixed uses existing prepared whole-object zstd. No codec tuning or implementation changes in this campaign.

measurement.bytes: Actual canonical encrypted envelope and framing counters, both directions, including readiness/status and all setup publications; compare sender and receiver counters. Excludes TCP/IP headers and retransmission.
measurement.cpu: One aggregate ProcessTime interval, plus sender and receiver ThreadTime intervals. Original campaign cpu_us values use overlapping process clocks; retain but never sum them as endpoint CPU.
measurement.time: From before provisioning through sender completion, receiver durable publication and exact independent reopen verification. Additional offline re-verification and payload cleanup timed separately. Include all fixture/codec generation setup performed by both roles.
measurement.memory: Kernel lifetime process peak RSS; new process per cell. No energy or send-only-time inference.
measurement.interpretation: One fixed-order pilot per cell, not randomized repeated trials or a statistical speedup claim. Preserve losses and failed gates.

resource_policy.bounds_note: Fixed fixture/size/trial validation precedes allocation. RSS and store gates are post-execution checks, not allocator or filesystem quotas. Do not run benchmark cells concurrently with owned builds/tests.
resource_policy.payload_cleanup: Create a new owned scratch directory per cell; flush compact exact-verified evidence before deleting its payload store. Errors preserve the owned partial store until failure record and inventory are retained, then only explicit owned cleanup is allowed.
resource_policy.local_hdd: No payload datasets copied to Mac; compact JSON/test results only. No new VM disk or toolchain.

gates: All completed objects pass exact length and byte reopen comparisons.
Actual sender and receiver envelope/framing/frame counters agree.
All eight target fixtures represented, plus two setup publications only for CombinedCpu.
No hidden raw fallback under a new transfer identity or witness limit increase.
Failed or partial cells remain explicit and cannot establish a matched successful comparison.
Successful cell evidence flushed before deleting owned payloads; post-execution RSS and store gates pass.
